opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search and select fastest direct flexible ticket
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Flights, search a one-way or multi-city itinerary with given legs, dates and passenger count, restrict to direct flights, sort by Fastest, select a flight and choose the Flexible ticket.
steps: Open Booking.com and click the Flights tab
Choose trip type (One way / Multi-city)
Tick 'Direct flights only'
Enter origin airport/city for leg 1 and pick from suggestions
Enter destination for leg 1 and pick from suggestions
Pick departure date for leg 1
For multi-city: fill origin, destination and date for each further leg
Set the number of adults and click Done
Click Search
Optionally apply a departure-time filter, then click the 'Fastest' tab
Click 'See flight' on the chosen result and click Select
Choose the Flexible ticket and click Next

instances.values: One way BLR Bangalore -> GOI Goa, Wed 29 Mar, 2 adults, direct, departs 18:00-23:59, Fastest, SpiceJet, Flexible ticket
Multi-city New York -> Tokyo Thu 1 Jun, Tokyo -> DEL Delhi Mon 5 Jun, 1 adult, direct, Fastest, Japan Airlines, Flexible ticket

opportunities.name: Expedia rental car search with filters
opportunities.description: On Expedia Cars, search rental cars for a given pick-up location, dates and times, then filter by car type, capacity or rental company and sort the results.
steps: Open Expedia and click the Cars tab
Click Pick-up, type the location and pick a suggestion
Set the drop-off location (same as pick-up or select it)
Open the date picker, choose pick-up and drop-off dates, click Done
Set pick-up and drop-off times
Click Search
Apply filters (car type, capacity, rental company)
Optionally change the sort order

instances.values: JFK pick-up and drop-off, Apr 3-6, 9:00 am-6:00 pm, 2-5 passengers, Luxury, sort changed
San Francisco, Apr 8-9, 10:30 am, rental company Avis, Economy

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search
opportunities.description: On Carnival, search cruises by destination, departure port and month, then refine the results by number of guests.
steps: On the Carnival homepage, open 'Sail To' and pick a destination
Optionally open 'Sail From' and pick a departure port
Optionally open Dates and pick a month/year
Click Search Cruises
On the results page, open 'Number of Guests' and set the guest count
Review the results sorted Low to High

instances.values: Panama Canal, from San Francisco CA, Oct 2024
Caribbean, any port and dates, guests set to 3 then 4

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, search airport parking for a given airport and start/end dates, then review and sort the listings.
steps: Open SpotHero and click the Airport tab
Click the search box and pick the airport from the list
On the results page, set the parking start date
Set the parking end date and click Search
Open the sort dropdown (Featured) to change the order

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup
opportunities.description: On the MTA website, open Planned Service Changes and look up a route's planned changes for a selected date.
steps: Open the MTA homepage and go to Planned Work / Planned Service Changes
Click 'Search Routes', type the route and pick it from suggestions
Optionally open the date picker and choose a date
Review the results for the route
